basis_policy: ez-wo15-hfbtho-basis-v1: spherical HFB, 14 oscillator shells, max 300 iterations, accuracy 1e-05, Lipkin-Nogami off, identical for every family and every nuclide
immutability_rule: ez-wo15-artifact-immutable-v1: a parameter artifact is immutable from B004 preregistration onward. Its id is the digest of its own content, so any change to a parameter, objective, membership, or build produces a different id — an edit in place is not representable
pairing_definition: volume delta pairing, strengths vpair_n / vpair_p in MeV fm^3 with a 60 MeV quasiparticle cutoff and pairing_feature 0.5, as implemented by HFBTHO's user_pairing path

parameterization_source.calibration_note: refit of SkM constrained by the fission barrier of 240Pu plus nuclear-matter and selected finite-nucleus data; exact nuclide membership is not machine-readable
parameterization_source.provenance_reasoning: the refitted parameters have exact calibration membership and consumed AME1995 evidence only, so the pairing sector is REFIT_STRICT; the underlying SKM* bulk functional is a pre-freeze publication with prose-level calibration membership, recorded here as its own HISTORICAL_FROZEN_PARTIAL provenance
parameterization_source.publication: Bartel, Quentin, Brack, Guet, Hakansson, Nucl. Phys. A386 (1982) 79
parameterization_source.refit_scope: pairing sector only (vpair_n, vpair_p); the bulk EDF stays at its published historical values
